project_identity.name: 0x07-networking_basics
project_identity.scope: Introduction to fundamental networking concepts including the OSI model, types of networks, IP addressing, and network protocols.
project_identity.description: Covers OSI model, TCP/IP, IP addressing, network types, protocols, and troubleshooting tools.

technicalSkills: Understand the OSI model and its seven layers
Differentiate between LAN, WAN, and Internet network types
Work with MAC addresses and understand their purpose
Distinguish between TCP and UDP protocols
Identify key port numbers and their associated services
Use network diagnostic tools like ping and netstat
Recognize the differences between private and public IP addresses
Monitor and analyze network traffic and connections

prerequisites: Basic understanding of command line operations
